name: Talaan
notes: Talaan V2.2.0 adds a local CSV import center with reusable mappings, Philippine date and amount parsing, preview, duplicate detection, rule suggestions, recovery snapshots, and single-import rollback. Finance Schema 12, Cloud Schema V3, account balances, Account Ledger entries, paid-state calculations, recurrence, project payments, encryption, backups, and synchronization semantics are preserved.
